environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. The LDAP service account (cn=svc-lookup) has read access to the entire directory tree including ou=admins and ou=services subtrees. The application is exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no request inspection. The LDAP server contains sensitive attributes including userPassword hashes, SSH keys in sshPublicKey, and internal service credentials in description fields. The service account can enumerate all organizational units.

config.network: NLB passthrough, no WAF, port 3000 exposed
config.ldap_acl: svc-lookup has subtree read on dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com (all attributes)
